recipeeditor.config.title: Recipe Studio (Universal Recipe Editor)
recipeeditor.gui.tooltip_shaped: Craft items with a fixed pattern in a 3x3 grid
recipeeditor.gui.tooltip_smithing: Upgrade equipment using smithing templates (e.g. Diamond to Netherite)
recipeeditor.gui.tooltip_smelting: Standard smelting of ores, materials, and food
recipeeditor.gui.tooltip_blasting: Fast blasting of ores, metals, and equipment
recipeeditor.gui.tooltip_smoking: Fast cooking of meat and fish food items
recipeeditor.gui.tooltip_stonecutting: Precision stone cutting for blocks and stairs
recipeeditor.gui.tooltip_campfire: Cook food over a campfire without consuming fuel
recipeeditor.gui.reset_confirm_msg: This action will delete all your configured recipes, are you sure?
recipeeditor.gui.select_item_hint: Select an item in catalog using right mouse button (RMB)
recipeeditor.gui.hint_1: 💡 RMB — Load item craft from catalog
recipeeditor.gui.hint_2: 💡 LMB — Drag item to selected crafting slot
recipeeditor.gui.hint_4: 💡 Drag & drop from catalog to crafting slots is supported
recipeeditor.gui.hint_5: 💡 RMB on a crafting slot clears it immediately
